Alger County.note: The listing's last line prints 721 Candidates as of Fri Sep 04 08:48:42 EDT. Names are copied in the order printed on the official candidate listing. The Party / Incumbent column is copied as printed. When that column prints INCUMBENT and no party name, the party cell on this page is INCUMBENT. When that column is blank, no party is printed. A row whose Status cell prints DISQ or WITHD is not copied. The Filed On and Filing Method cells are not copied. Governor, secretary of state, attorney general, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, the Michigan Legislature, the State Board of Education, the university boards, the Supreme Court, and the Court of Appeals are not copied. County clerk, sheriff, treasurer, prosecutor, register of deeds, county commissioner, and city offices are not on this listing and are not copied. A circuit contest is printed on each Census county named in that circuit's consists-of sentence. When the section prints a later Beginning date that is already in effect, that sentence is the one used. The 5th, 33rd, 40th, and 56th circuit contests are not copied, because those sections state the counties inside an if-the-county-approves sentence and the candidate listing does not name the county. A probate contest is printed on the county named at the start of the office line.
